# AI Seller Index
> Independent directory of AI tools for Amazon FBA, Shopify and e-commerce sellers with honest verdicts.

## Product Research
- [Jungle Scout](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/jungle-scout/): Amazon market intelligence and product validation. Limitation: Estimates are modeled, not actual sales. Pricing: From $49/mo
- [Helium 10](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/helium-10/): All-in-one Amazon suite (research, keywords, listings, PPC). Limitation: Broad but deep tiers get pricey; learning curve. Pricing: Platinum $129/mo ($99/mo billed yearly); Diamond/Enterprise higher
- [SmartScout](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/smartscout/): Brand/seller-level market mapping and wholesale sourcing. Limitation: Less useful for private-label keyword work. Pricing: $49/$119/$299 monthly; $29/$99/$239 per month billed yearly. Code AISELLERINDEX: 25% off your first 3 months
- [Viral Launch](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/viral-launch/): Product discovery plus keyword research. Limitation: Overlaps heavily with Jungle Scout/Helium 10. Pricing: No longer sold (shut down; site parked)
- [SellerSprite](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sellersprite/): Low-cost keyword and product research across marketplaces. Limitation: UI/translation rough in places. Pricing: From $39/mo (Basic)
- [Keepa](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/keepa/): Price/BSR history tracking. Limitation: Not AI-driven; data-heavy charts. Pricing: From €29/mo (Keepa Pro); free tier available
- [SellerApp](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sellerapp/): Research plus PPC automation in one. Limitation: Jack of all trades. Pricing: Free; Pro from $99/mo
- [ProductPinion](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/productpinion/): Shopper polls and video feedback to test product ideas and listings before launch. Limitation: Tests opinions, not real sales data; extra responses cost more. Pricing: Starter $57/mo, Brand $97/mo, Agency $1,129/mo (credits included)
- [PickFu](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pickfu/): Fast consumer polls for comparing images, titles, packaging and product ideas. Limitation: Pay-per-response adds up for large tests; panel opinions are not purchase behavior. Pricing: From $1 per response pay-as-you-go; PickFu+ from $999/yr
- [Threecolts](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/threecolts/): Suite of seller tools including online arbitrage sourcing and repricing. Limitation: Many separate products with separate pricing; reseller-focused. Pricing: Sourcing plans from $69/mo ($65/mo yearly); Teams $129/mo; other products priced separately
- [ZIK Analytics](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zik-analytics/): eBay product and competitor research. Limitation: eBay-focused. Pricing: PRO $39.90/mo, or $14/mo billed annually
- [Launch Fast](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/launch-fast/): AI market reports, supplier quotes, and MCP agent access for Amazon product validation. Limitation: Credit limits on research/AI reports; Chrome extension alone is not a full substitute for deep dashboard work. Pricing: From $49/mo
- [Sell The Trend](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sell-the-trend/): NEXUS AI winning-product discovery plus Facebook/TikTok ad spy for dropship and Shopify sellers. Limitation: Built for dropship/import workflows more than Amazon private-label brand building; trial requires a payment method. Pricing: From $29.97/mo
- [Minea](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/minea/): Ad-spy and AI ad analysis to find proven ecommerce creatives and winning products. Limitation: AI analysis/transcript quotas on lower plans; strongest for paid-social discovery, not Amazon keyword research. Pricing: From $49/mo
- [EchoTik](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/echotik/): TikTok Shop product, creator, live, and video analytics with AI analysis tools. Limitation: Free plan is heavily capped; paid prices shown are billed yearly; not an Amazon research tool. Pricing: Free; paid from $9.9/mo (billed yearly)
- [ZonBase](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zonbase/): Amazon product and keyword research bundled with training. Limitation: Plans mix tools with training, so you may pay for lessons you don't need. Pricing: Standard $49/mo or $399/yr; Legendary $109/mo or $999/yr; Diamond $299/mo or $2,399/yr
- [SellerAmp SAS](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/selleramp-sas/): Fast profit, ROI and restriction checks when sourcing products for Amazon. Limitation: A sourcing calculator, not a full suite for ads or listings. Pricing: Getting Started $19.95/mo, Getting Serious $29.95/mo, Going Pro $49.95/mo
- [ScanUnlimited](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/scanunlimited/): Bulk-scanning supplier price lists against Amazon to find profitable items. Limitation: Works from files you upload; free plan is limited to 1 upload a month. Pricing: Limited free (1 file upload/mo); Unlimited $70/mo ($60/mo on the annual plan)
- [Seller Assistant App](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/seller-assistant-app/): Chrome extension and price-list tools for checking Amazon profit, ROI and selling restrictions while sourcing. Limitation: Built for sourcing; not a tool for ads or listing writing. Pricing: Pro $29.99/mo, Business $79.99/mo, Business Plus $189.99/mo ($24.99, $69.99, $159.99/mo billed yearly); 14-day free trial
- [BuyBotPro](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/buybotpro/): Automated deal analysis for online and retail arbitrage, with a buy or don't-buy check per product. Limitation: Main pricing page is in GBP plus VAT; a sourcing checker, not a full seller suite. Pricing: From £11.95/mo plus VAT (Lite); Advanced £24.95, Professional £34.95, Enterprise £99.95 per month; 30-day free trial
- [RevSeller](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/revseller/): Low-cost Chrome extension that shows fees, profit and variations right on Amazon product pages. Limitation: An on-page calculator only; no product finding or deal lists. Pricing: $99.99/yr ($8.33/mo) or $19.99/mo; 30-day free trial, no card needed

## Listing Optimization
- [ZonGuru](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zonguru/): AI listing engineering (Helix) for Amazon. Limitation: Now listing-focused and priced per catalog size; costly for one-product sellers. Pricing: Helix $149/$299/$699/mo (monthly); ~17% less yearly
- [Datadive](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/datadive/): Keyword ranking juice and listing optimization from competitor data. Limitation: Analytical; not for casual users. Pricing: $39/mo (Starter, monthly), $124/mo (yearly) and $408/mo Enterprise (yearly); see page
- [Helium 10 Listing Builder](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/helium-10-listing-builder/): AI listing copy with keyword coverage scoring. Limitation: Requires Helium 10 subscription. Pricing: Included in Helium 10 plans (Platinum $129/mo)
- [Jasper](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/jasper/): Brand-voice copy for product pages and ads. Limitation: Not Amazon-specific; needs keyword input from another tool. Pricing: $59–$69/mo per seat
- [Copy.ai](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/copy-ai/): Go-to-market AI workflows for sales and marketing teams. Limitation: Repositioned as GTM platform; not marketplace-aware, overkill for listings. Pricing: From $29/mo ($24/mo yearly); enterprise ~$1,000/mo
- [Superfuel](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/superfuel/): AI agent that writes Amazon listings and measures the results. Limitation: Priced by product count; generated copy still needs a compliance check. Pricing: Free trial (5 products); Starter $49/mo (10 products); Growth $199/mo (40 products)
- [Optiwise.ai](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/optiwise/): Walmart listing and ad optimization. Limitation: Walmart-focused; little value for Amazon-only sellers. Pricing: Free tier; paid 3P plans $249–$4,999/mo by revenue and SKU count
- [Writesonic](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/writesonic/): AI content and SEO writing. Limitation: Not Amazon-listing specific; pricey higher tiers. Pricing: Starter $79, Basic $199, Growth $399 per month (billed annually)
- [Rytr](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/rytr/): Cheap AI writer for descriptions. Limitation: Generic AI copy; needs editing and keyword research elsewhere. Pricing: Free; Unlimited $7.50/mo; Premium $24.16/mo
- [Describely](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/describely/): Bulk AI product descriptions and data enrichment. Limitation: Pay-per-product adds up for big catalogs. Pricing: $0.75 per product (up to 500), no subscription
- [SEO Booster (SEOAnt)](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/seo-booster/): Shopify SEO audits and fixes. Limitation: Shopify only. Pricing: Premium $39/mo, Enterprise $99/mo
- [Avada SEO Suite](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/avada-seo/): Shopify SEO, structured data and image alt text. Limitation: Shopify only. Pricing: Pro $34.95/mo, Enterprise $99/mo
- [Plug in SEO](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/plug-in-seo/): SEO problem scanner for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify only. Pricing: Lite $29.99, Standard $49.99, Premium $79.99 per month
- [StoreSEO](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/storeseo/): AI SEO for Shopify products. Limitation: Product limits per plan. Pricing: Lite $14.99, Essential $39.99, Advanced $249.99 per month
- [CopyMonkey](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/copymonkey/): Keyword-led Amazon title, bullets, and description drafts at catalog scale. Limitation: AI drafts still need human compliance and brand-voice review before go-live. Pricing: From $49/mo
- [Ecomtent](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/ecomtent/): AI-written product listing content plus AI search visibility analytics. Limitation: Pricey for small sellers; plans are capped by SKUs per month. Pricing: From $599/mo (25 SKUs/mo), with discounts for longer billing; $1,599/mo and $5,999/mo tiers

## PPC & Ads
- [Perpetua](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/perpetua/): Goal-based Amazon/Walmart ad automation. Limitation: Less granular manual control. Pricing: From $695/mo; Growth adds % of ad spend
- [Teikametrics](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/teikametrics/): AI bid optimization tied to inventory/profit. Limitation: Pricing scales with ad spend. Pricing: Essentials $149/mo yearly or $179/mo monthly (up to $10K ad spend); higher tiers custom
- [Ad Badger](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/ad-badger/): Rules-based Amazon PPC bid automation. Limitation: Older UI; less AI than rivals. Pricing: From $275/mo (Starter, up to $5K ad spend)
- [Quartile](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/quartile/): Managed + AI ad optimization across retail channels. Limitation: Enterprise-oriented. Pricing: Custom quote (no public pricing)
- [Pacvue](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pacvue/): Enterprise retail media management. Limitation: Overkill and costly for small sellers. Pricing: Custom quote (no public pricing)
- [Scale Insights](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/scale-insights/): Template-based Amazon PPC automation. Limitation: Setup takes effort. Pricing: From $78/mo (5 automated ASINs)
- [Adbrew](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/adbrew/): Amazon Sponsored Ads automation, insights and reporting. Limitation: Entry price is high for small sellers; cost scales with ad spend. Pricing: Standard $799/mo or a % of ad spend, whichever is greater
- [atom11](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/atom11/): Amazon ads automation with rule-based bidding and retail analytics. Limitation: Starting price is steep for small accounts; higher tiers are sales-led. Pricing: Beginner $499/mo (ad spend up to $50K/mo); Professional from $1,199/mo; Enterprise custom
- [Aakaar AI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/aakaar-ai/): Agentic AI platform for Amazon PPC optimization. Limitation: Starts at $199–$300/mo; brands over $1M/mo get custom pricing. Pricing: Claude/ChatGPT plan from $199/mo; Agentic AI Platform from $300/mo; 30-day money-back guarantee
- [Trellis](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/trellis/): AI ad scaling plus dynamic pricing for Amazon and Walmart. Limitation: No public price; demo-led sales. Pricing: Not verified (no public price found on vendor pricing page, Oct 14, 2026)
- [Xnurta](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/xnurta/): AI retail media management for Amazon, Walmart and Criteo. Limitation: Minimum $750/mo makes it a fit only once ad spend is substantial. Pricing: Lead $750/mo or 3% of ad spend; Enterprise custom
- [Adspert](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/adspert/): AI bid management for Amazon and Google Ads. Limitation: Base fee plus a % of managed ad spend, so cost grows with spend. Pricing: €99, €499, €999 per month plus a % commission on optimized ad spend (from 1.7%)
- [Signalytics](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/signalytics/): AI-assisted Amazon PPC with optional managed service. Limitation: Feature limits per tier are based on AI 'credits'; check what you need. Pricing: SaaS: Starter $45, Growth $95, Professional $195 per month ($450/$950/$1,950 yearly)
- [Optmyzr](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/optmyzr/): Google and Microsoft Ads optimization toolkit. Limitation: Not for Amazon Ads; priced by ad spend. Pricing: From $209/mo, scaling with ad spend
- [Birch (formerly Revealbot)](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/birch/): Rules-based automation for Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat ads. Limitation: Not for Amazon Ads; price rises with ad spend. Pricing: Essential and Pro plans from $49–$99/mo at up to $10K ad spend; higher spend costs more
- [AdEspresso](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/adespresso/): Facebook and Instagram ad testing and management. Limitation: Starter plan caps ad spend at $1,000/mo. Pricing: Starter $49/mo, Plus $99/mo, Enterprise from $259/mo
- [Pencil](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pencil/): AI-generated ad creatives for social campaigns. Limitation: Generation limits per plan; AI output still needs review. Pricing: Core $14/mo ($11 yearly), Growth $55/mo ($44 yearly)
- [BidX](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/bidx/): Automated Amazon Ads bidding and campaign structure. Limitation: Price not shown on its pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [Intentwise](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/intentwise/): Amazon and Walmart ads management and analytics. Limitation: Enterprise-oriented; no public prices. Pricing: not verified
- [Sellozo](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sellozo/): AI automation for Amazon PPC. Limitation: Price not shown on its pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [Madgicx](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/madgicx/): AI tools for Meta ads targeting, creative and reporting. Limitation: Price depends on ad spend; not for Amazon Ads. Pricing: not verified
- [Circes](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/circes/): AI next-move recommendations across Amazon ads, inventory, pricing, and margins with human approval. Limitation: Early-access founding plan; access is request-based, not instant self-serve signup. Pricing: From $250/mo (Founding Member; planned list $500/mo)
- [m19](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/m19/): Hands-off Amazon Sponsored Products automation (Autopilot) with a clear entry price. Limitation: Autopilot is SP-only; Professional adds % of ad spend and is aimed at higher spend. Pricing: From $59/mo

## Inventory & Forecasting
- [Inventory Planner](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/inventory-planner/): Demand forecasting and POs for Shopify/multi-channel. Limitation: Now part of Sage; pricing by revenue. Pricing: From $119.99/mo (Essentials); higher plans custom quote
- [Prediko](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/prediko/): AI demand forecasting for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify-only focus. Pricing: From $49/mo (under $100k GMV)
- [SoStocked](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sostocked/): Amazon inventory forecasting and reorder planning. Limitation: Amazon-centric; pricing not published on site. Pricing: From $175/mo (Inventory + Profit)
- [Cin7](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/cin7/): Inventory and order management across channels and warehouses. Limitation: Costly for small sellers. Pricing: From $349/mo; $599/mo and $1,199/mo tiers (USD, excl. tax)
- [Fabrikator](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/fabrikator/): Shopify inventory planning, purchase orders and forecasting. Limitation: Shopify-focused; price scales with revenue. Pricing: From $79/mo (billed yearly, $0–500K revenue); revenue-based tiers
- [Ordoro](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/ordoro/): Inventory sync, dropshipping and shipping labels. Limitation: Inventory features sit on separate, pricier plans than shipping. Pricing: Shipping free/$59/$149 per month; inventory from $349/mo; dropshipping from $299/mo
- [StockTrim](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/stocktrim/): Demand forecasting and reorder suggestions. Limitation: Pricing depends on revenue band; check the calculator. Pricing: not verified
- [Flieber](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/flieber/): Inventory planning for omnichannel and Amazon brands. Limitation: Price not published on its pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [RestockPro (eComEngine)](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/restockpro/): FBA restock forecasting and purchase orders. Limitation: Amazon-focused; priced by FBA order volume. Pricing: Starting at $49/mo (1,000 FBA orders)

## Customer Service
- [Gorgias](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/gorgias/): E-com helpdesk with AI agent and Shopify integration. Limitation: Ticket-based pricing adds up. Pricing: Starter $40/mo; higher tiers from $77/mo yearly; AI Agent add-on
- [Tidio](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/tidio/): Chat widget plus Lyro AI agent. Limitation: AI usage billed separately. Pricing: Free; paid $24.17–$49.17/mo (annual), AI add-on extra
- [Yuma AI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/yuma-ai/): Autonomous AI support agent on top of helpdesks. Limitation: Needs an existing helpdesk. Pricing: From $14,400/yr (~$1.20 per resolution)
- [Zipchat](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zipchat/): AI sales/support chat for Shopify. Limitation: Smaller vendor. Pricing: From $64/mo (billed yearly)
- [eDesk](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/edesk/): Marketplace-native helpdesk (Amazon, eBay, Shopify). Limitation: Less suited to pure DTC. Pricing: From $39/agent/mo yearly ($49 monthly); AI agent $0.99 per outcome
- [Re:amaze](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/reamaze/): Shared inbox + live chat for Shopify stores. Limitation: Per-seat pricing adds up; AI resolutions beyond the included quota cost extra. Pricing: Basic $29, Pro $49, Plus $69 per team member/mo (about 10% less billed annually); AI agent $0.85 per extra resolution
- [Richpanel](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/richpanel/): Self-service order tracking and returns plus helpdesk. Limitation: Pricing is split across order-volume and per-user plans, so total cost takes some working out. Pricing: Self-service: free up to 50 orders/mo, $50/mo Starter, $600/mo Pro; helpdesk: free, $29 or $99 per user/mo
- [Zendesk](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zendesk/): Full-scale ticketing across email, chat and phone. Limitation: Heavy for a solo seller; AI Copilot is an extra $50/agent/mo. Pricing: From $19/agent/mo (Support Team, billed yearly); Suite $55 and $115/agent/mo billed yearly
- [Freshdesk](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/freshdesk/): Affordable ticketing with an AI agent add-on. Limitation: Not e-commerce-specific; AI agent sessions are billed separately ($49 per 100). Pricing: $19 and $55 per agent/mo billed annually; Freddy AI Copilot $29/agent/mo
- [Help Scout](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/help-scout/): Simple, email-first shared inbox. Limitation: Fewer e-com order integrations than Gorgias or Richpanel; AI Answers billed per resolution. Pricing: Standard $25, Plus $45, Pro $75 per user/mo; AI Answers $0.75 per resolution
- [Intercom](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/intercom/): AI agent (Fin) plus helpdesk and in-app chat. Limitation: Per-outcome AI charges are hard to predict; built for SaaS more than e-com. Pricing: Helpdesk $19, $85, $132 per seat/mo; Fin AI Agent $0.99 per outcome
- [Siena AI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/siena-ai/): AI agent that handles e-com support tickets end to end. Limitation: $750/mo platform fee before any tickets — not for small sellers. Pricing: $750/mo platform fee plus $0.90 per automated ticket
- [Chatbase](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/chatbase/): Build a custom AI chatbot trained on your store's content. Limitation: General-purpose; you set up and maintain the training content yourself. Pricing: Hobby $40/mo ($32 billed yearly); Standard $150/mo ($120 billed yearly)
- [Kustomer](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/kustomer/): CRM-style helpdesk with AI for high-volume brands. Limitation: Aimed at large teams; price not published on its pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [Robylon](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/robylon/): Shopify sellers who want one AI support agent across chat, email, WhatsApp and voice. Limitation: No Amazon integration; free plan is chat only (~40 conversations/mo); voice and Zendesk/Freshdesk handoff need the $180/mo Business plan. Pricing: Free Starter (300 credits/mo, ~40 conversations); Pro from $25/mo (500 credits); Business from $180/mo; 10% off yearly

## Image & Creative
- [Pebblely](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pebblely/): AI product lifestyle backgrounds. Limitation: Results vary; check Amazon image rules. Pricing: Lite $9, Basic $19, Pro $39/mo
- [Photoroom](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/photoroom/): Background removal and batch product photos. Limitation: Generated scenes still need review. Pricing: Pro $7.50/mo, Max $20.99/mo, Ultra $82.50/mo (billed yearly)
- [Flair.ai](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/flair-ai/): AI product photoshoots with brand control. Limitation: Learning curve for best results. Pricing: Free; Pro from $8/mo billed annually
- [Claid.ai](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/claid-ai/): Image enhancement/standardization at catalog scale. Limitation: API-oriented. Pricing: From $15/mo (Essentials)
- [Canva](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/canva/): Infographics, A+ content, ads with Magic AI tools. Limitation: Generic templates look generic. Pricing: Free; Pro from $18/mo ($144/yr)
- [Pixii](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pixii/): AI-generated Amazon listing images, A+ content and product videos. Limitation: Credit-based; paid plans start well above simple photo editors, and AI visuals still need a human check for accuracy. Pricing: Free trial (210 credits); Growth $249/mo, Scale $749/mo billed monthly; Enterprise custom
- [Kreator.ai](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/kreator-ai/): Turning product photos into ad creative (images and video). Limitation: Ad-creative focus rather than Amazon listing images; output still needs review. Pricing: Starter $99/mo, Growth $299/mo, Scale $599/mo billed monthly
- [Pixelcut](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pixelcut/): Quick background removal and AI product photos. Limitation: Credit-based; heavy batch work needs Business plan. Pricing: Free; Pro $10/mo ($8 yearly); Business $30/mo ($24 yearly)
- [Picsart](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/picsart/): All-round AI photo and video editor. Limitation: General creative tool, not built for marketplace image rules. Pricing: Pro $15/mo ($10.50 billed yearly); higher tier $47/mo ($37.50 yearly, per seat)
- [Creatopy](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/creatopy/): Ad creative design and resizing at scale. Limitation: More for ad teams than single-listing image work. Pricing: $29/mo (Create Pro), $49/seat/mo (Team), $79/mo (Ultra), billed annually
- [Mokker AI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/mokker/): AI product photo backgrounds from templates. Limitation: AI scenes can look generic; check against Amazon main-image rules. Pricing: Starter $13/mo; Team $29/user/mo; Organization $83.25/user/mo
- [remove.bg](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/remove-bg/): One-click background removal, with API. Limitation: Does one job only; credit pricing. Pricing: not verified
- [TinyIMG](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/tinyimg/): Image compression and SEO for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify-focused. Pricing: Beginner $14, Advanced $23, Expert $49 per month
- [PictMagic](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/pictmagic/): Planning and generating full Amazon listing image sets plus A+ modules from one product photo. Limitation: Credit-based; AI can invent details—review every image before publishing; free downloads are watermarked. Pricing: From $19/mo (Free starter credits available)
- [AdCreative.ai](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/adcreative-ai/): Bulk AI ad creatives, product photoshoots, and video ads with creative scoring. Limitation: Credits are spent on downloads, not generations; not Amazon A+/listing-image focused. Pricing: From $39/mo
- [Creatify](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/creatify/): AI product and UGC-style video ads from a URL or product assets. Limitation: Credit-based video generation; quality still needs human review before paid spend. Pricing: From $15/mo

## Multi-channel & Ops
- [Feedonomics](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/feedonomics/): Managed product feed optimization across channels. Limitation: Enterprise pricing. Pricing: Custom quote (by SKU/channels; no % of revenue)
- [Linnworks](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/linnworks/): Multi-channel inventory/order management. Limitation: Implementation effort. Pricing: Custom quote (by monthly order volume)
- [ChannelEngine](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/channelengine/): Marketplace integration hub. Limitation: Enterprise-leaning. Pricing: Custom quote (GMV + success fee)
- [Channable](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/channable/): Product feed management for Google Shopping, marketplaces and ad channels. Limitation: Prices are in euros and modular; add-ons (CSS, marketplaces) are billed separately. Pricing: Core from €59/mo (Standard), €79 Plus, €89 Pro; CSS and marketplace add-ons from €29–€30/mo
- [Goflow](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/goflow/): Multichannel order, inventory, fulfillment and EDI management. Limitation: Full features start at $499/mo; EDI setup fees of $500–$1,300 per connection. Pricing: Goflow Core free; subscription from $499/mo, month-to-month
- [SureDone](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/suredone/): Multichannel listing and catalog management, strong in auto parts fitment. Limitation: Interface and setup are heavier than lighter listing tools. Pricing: Not verified (no public price found on vendor pricing page, Oct 14, 2026); pricing page blocked automated access
- [Jarvio](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/jarvio/): AI agents and workflows for running Amazon brand operations. Limitation: Per-brand pricing; broad scope means less depth than single-purpose tools. Pricing: Growth $149 per brand/mo (14-day free trial); higher tiers by revenue
- [Zentail](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zentail/): Central catalog and order routing for Walmart, Target Plus and Amazon. Limitation: Annual contracts; Pro tier is expensive. Pricing: Base from $300/mo; Pro from $2,000/mo (annual contract)
- [StoreAutomator](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/storeautomator/): Multichannel listing, order and inventory management. Limitation: No public prices; sales-led onboarding. Pricing: Not verified (no public price found on vendor pricing page, Oct 14, 2026)
- [Flashpricer](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/flashpricer/): Fast repricing to win the Buy Box on Amazon and Walmart. Limitation: Repricing only; brands with private label may not need it. Pricing: $99/mo (Starter) to $559/mo (Enterprise); 14-day free trial
- [Sellercloud](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sellercloud/): Inventory, order and warehouse management across marketplaces. Limitation: Expensive; warehouse module costs extra. Pricing: Essentials from $1,349/mo, Growth from $1,849/mo; WMS typically +$500–$650/mo
- [Aura](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/aura/): Fast AI repricer for Amazon. Limitation: Repricing only; can trigger price wars if set too aggressively. Pricing: Billed annually: Starter $37, Essential $77, Plus $157, Pro $237 per month
- [Informed.co](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/informed/): Repricing for Amazon, Walmart and more. Limitation: Faster repricing (Overdrive) costs extra. Pricing: Launch $99/mo, Professional $199/mo, Enterprise from $499/mo; Overdrive add-on $29/mo
- [Seller Snap](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/seller-snap/): AI repricer using game-theory pricing. Limitation: Starter limited to 1,000 SKUs and $15K/mo revenue. Pricing: Starter $100/mo (annual); Accelerator $250/mo ($212 billed yearly)
- [Repricer.com](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/repricer-com/): Amazon repricing with Buy Box strategies. Limitation: Several add-ons are priced separately in euros. Pricing: $99, $299, $499 per month base plans
- [Alpha Repricer](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/alpha-repricer/): Budget Amazon repricer. Limitation: Lower tiers cap SKUs and revenue. Pricing: Starter $29/mo, Bronze $40/mo, Silver $60/mo and up
- [Boxem](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/boxem/): FBA shipment prep, labeling and shipping. Limitation: Mostly useful for FBA prep workflows. Pricing: From $49.99/mo ($38/mo billed annually); higher plan $69.99/mo
- [DataFeedWatch](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/datafeedwatch/): Product feed management for Google Shopping and marketplaces. Limitation: Costs more than Shopify feed apps. Pricing: Shop $64, Merchant $84, Agency $239 per month
- [GoDataFeed](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/godatafeed/): Feed management for shopping channels and marketplaces. Limitation: Pricing depends on SKUs and channels. Pricing: Plus plan $99/mo recommended at 1,000 SKUs; +$5 per 1,000 SKUs
- [Simprosys Google Shopping Feed](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/simprosys/): Cheap Google Shopping feeds for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify only; add-ons billed separately. Pricing: From $4.99/mo (up to 500 products)
- [Listing Mirror](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/listing-mirror/): List and sync inventory across marketplaces. Limitation: Price not shown on pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [RepricerExpress](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/repricerexpress/): Amazon and eBay repricing. Limitation: Price not shown on pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [InventoryLab](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/inventorylab/): Listing, FBA shipment prep and profit-and-loss tracking in one place. Limitation: Restock suggestions are a $25/mo add-on on the standalone plan. Pricing: $69/mo ($58/mo billed yearly); 30-day free trial

## Analytics & Profit
- [sellerboard](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sellerboard/): Accurate Amazon profit tracking incl. fees/PPC/COGS. Limitation: Amazon-focused; UI basic. Pricing: From $15/mo yearly ($19 monthly)
- [Triple Whale](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/triple-whale/): Shopify attribution and profit dashboards with AI. Limitation: Attribution is modeled; costly at scale. Pricing: Free; Foundation from $219/mo; Automate from $749/mo
- [Klaviyo](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/klaviyo/): Email/SMS with AI segmentation and predictive analytics. Limitation: Price grows with list size. Pricing: Free up to 250 profiles; paid scales with list size
- [Getida](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/getida/): FBA reimbursement recovery. Limitation: Commission-based; similar services exist. Pricing: 25% of recovered reimbursements (no monthly fee)
- [TrackIQ](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/trackiq/): AI analyst that turns Amazon retail, ads and AMC data into reports and alerts. Limitation: Priced per brand, so multi-brand costs add up; focused on Amazon. Pricing: MCP-only $69/mo; Solo Seller $149/mo, Growing Brand $349/mo, Established Brand $549/mo per brand
- [MerchantSpring](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/merchantspring/): Marketplace performance analytics across 120+ channels. Limitation: Built for reporting, not execution; higher price than single-seller profit tools. Pricing: Seller $399/mo ($319/mo yearly); Vendor $699/mo ($559/mo yearly)
- [ConnectBooks](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/connectbooks/): Syncing marketplace sales and fees into QuickBooks or Xero with profit reports. Limitation: Accounting sync, not an ads or research tool; price rises with order volume. Pricing: Gold from $149/mo, Diamond from $199/mo, Platinum from $349/mo (scales by order volume)
- [Seller Labs](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/seller-labs/): Amazon seller tools (keywords, feedback, ads insights). Limitation: Tiers are based on tool-call allowance, which takes getting used to. Pricing: Paid tiers include $39/mo for 101–400 tool calls per month
- [BeProfit](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/beprofit/): Shopify profit tracking and P&L. Limitation: Order caps per plan. Pricing: Basic $49, Pro $99, Ultimate $149 per month (Shopify App Store listing)
- [TrueProfit](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/trueprofit/): Real-time Shopify net-profit dashboard. Limitation: Per-extra-order fees on top of the base price. Pricing: Basic $35/mo (300 orders, $0.30 per extra), Advanced $60/mo and up
- [Lifetimely](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/lifetimely/): LTV, cohort and profit analytics for Shopify. Limitation: Amazon data is a $75/mo add-on. Pricing: S $49, M $149, L $299 per month by order volume
- [Lebesgue](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/lebesgue/): AI marketing and profit analytics for Shopify. Limitation: Attribution pixel is expensive ($749/mo). Pricing: Free; Ultimate $79/mo; Ultimate AI $149/mo
- [GorillaROI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/gorillaroi/): Amazon data in Google Sheets for custom P&L. Limitation: You build your own reports in Sheets. Pricing: Basic $99, Pro $199, Mega $399 per month
- [Peel Insights](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/peel/): Automated retention and cohort analytics for Shopify. Limitation: Not for small stores. Pricing: Core from $179/mo (annual) or $199/mo; Essentials from $449/mo
- [Elevar](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/elevar/): Server-side tracking and conversion data for Shopify. Limitation: Expensive for small stores. Pricing: Core $225/mo, Advanced $650/mo, Premium $1,250/mo
- [Metorik](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/metorik/): Reports and customer segments for WooCommerce and Shopify. Limitation: Price scales with combined order volume. Pricing: Starter plan $25/mo (all features)
- [Shopkeeper](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/shopkeeper/): Amazon profit and accounting reports. Limitation: Plans capped by monthly order count. Pricing: Starter $20, Intermediate $45, Master $90, Superseller $250 per month
- [Sellerise](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/sellerise/): Amazon profit analytics and seller tools. Limitation: Starter covers one seller account. Pricing: Starter $19.99/mo
- [A2X](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/a2x/): Accurate accounting entries from Amazon/Shopify payouts. Limitation: Bookkeeping tool, not an analytics dashboard. Pricing: From US$29/mo per channel (some channels from $79/mo)
- [Taxomate](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/taxomate/): Low-cost Amazon/e-com payout bookkeeping. Limitation: Fewer integrations than A2X. Pricing: Starter $12/mo billed annually ($140/yr)
- [Webgility](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/webgility/): E-commerce accounting automation into QuickBooks. Limitation: Extra orders cost $10/mo per 500. Pricing: $69, $129, $299 per month billed annually
- [Glew](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/glew/): Multichannel e-commerce BI. Limitation: Price not shown on pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [Polar Analytics](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/polar-analytics/): Shopify BI and attribution. Limitation: Price not shown on pricing page. Pricing: not verified
- [DataHawk](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/datahawk/): Amazon and Walmart analytics. Limitation: Custom plans only. Pricing: not verified
- [Northbeam](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/northbeam/): Multi-touch ad attribution. Limitation: Quote-based; aimed at big spenders. Pricing: not verified
- [Putler](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/putler/): Combined sales analytics across payment and store platforms. Limitation: Price depends on revenue; not clearly listed. Pricing: not verified
- [Octane AI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/octane-ai/): AI product quizzes and shopper data for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify-only; credit limits per plan, with overage billed at $0.10 per credit. Pricing: Basic $50/mo ($43/mo yearly), Plus $200/mo ($170/mo yearly), Enterprise $500+/mo; 14-day free trial

## Reviews & Feedback
- [FeedbackWhiz](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/feedbackwhiz/): Amazon review requests, monitoring, profit. Limitation: No longer sold on its own: feedbackwhiz.com now sends you to Threecolts Seller 365, a bigger bundle. Pricing: Now part of Threecolts Seller 365: Standard $69/mo ($65/mo yearly), 14-day free trial
- [Yotpo](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/yotpo/): Reviews, UGC and loyalty for Shopify. Limitation: Gets expensive. Pricing: Reviews free plan, paid from $15/mo; bundles $89–$169/mo
- [Judge.me](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/judge-me/): Affordable Shopify product reviews. Limitation: Less advanced AI than premium tools. Pricing: Free; Awesome $15/mo
- [Okendo](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/okendo/): Reviews/UGC/surveys for Shopify Plus-type brands. Limitation: Premium pricing. Pricing: Free; Essential from $19/mo
- [Stamped](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/stamped/): Reviews plus loyalty and retention for Shopify. Limitation: Expensive entry point for small stores. Pricing: Reviews $199/mo; plans start at $199/mo per product, $798/mo multi-product
- [Junip](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/junip/): Photo/video product reviews for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify-focused; advanced AI features only on the $299 plan. Pricing: Free; Core $29, Growth $79, Premium $299 per month
- [Fera](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/fera/): Low-cost reviews app with AI review replies. Limitation: Price tiers rise quickly with order volume. Pricing: From $9/mo ($7 billed yearly) up to $999/mo by tier
- [Trustpilot](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/trustpilot/): Company reviews on a widely recognized third-party site. Limitation: Paid plans are pricey per domain; not a product-review widget first. Pricing: Free plan; Starter from $99, Plus from $319, Premium from $799 per month per domain (billed annually)
- [Loox](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/loox/): Photo and video reviews for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify only; order-based pricing grows with volume. Pricing: From $49.99/mo (300 orders, +$50 per extra 300); Unlimited $299.99/mo (Shopify App Store listing)
- [FeedbackFive (eComEngine)](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/feedbackfive/): Automated Amazon review and seller feedback requests. Limitation: Amazon-only; review volume still depends on buyers. Pricing: Starting at $34/mo (order-volume tiers)
- [Zonmaster](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/zonmaster/): Cheap Amazon buyer email and review-request automation. Limitation: Basic interface; limited live support on low tiers. Pricing: Free; Mini $7/mo; Basic $10/mo and up
- [VOC.AI](https://aisellerindex.com/tools/voc-ai/): AI analysis of Amazon product reviews from an ASIN. Limitation: It analyzes reviews; it does not send review requests. Pricing: Free 3-day trial (3 analyses); Personal $99/mo, Team $299/mo
